name: An exhausted iterator answers the same done singleton forever

input.source_text: module M { public fun run() -> Array { let a = [1]; let base = a.share_count(); mut it = a.iterator(); it.next(); it.next(); let after = a.share_count(); let one = it.next(); let two = it.next(); [after == base, one == Iteration.done, two == Iteration.done, one == two, a.share_count() == base] } } M.run()

applicability.reason: Collectibility is observed as the released source reference rather than by forcing a collection.
